title: Kidspedia Books
note: Session TB2. The shelf ORDER for every Kidspedia topic book, planned and built. public/kidspedia.html reads this file, loads each book's own /explore/{id}.json, and shows ONLY the books whose status is approved — so an id listed here that has no file yet (or is still in-review) simply does not appear. That is why every one of the 20 planned topics is listed from day one: TB3/TB4 just add the JSON file and the book takes its place on the right shelf with nothing else to remember. Never rename a shipped id: dog-ears are keyed on it.
